originalSourceEvidence: Original owner-provided Nature Synthesis/Nature Chemistry full main papers and SI were read in R1/R2 and frozen as 22 authentic original image rasters; original R2 QA/PDF SHA retained.
R2Problem: R2 was factually dense but enumerated journal Fig1→Fig2→scope→mechanism in an expository voice; neither asked a strong motivating chemical question early nor offered an evolving explanation until each experiment had been introduced.

evidenceTaxonomy: Directly observed/published measurement vs compatible inference vs calculated mechanistic pathway vs unsettled inference stated separately. Original source figure and SI item references adjacent to each claim.
